author.name: Automation Alex
author.role: Builds automated ML pipelines to ensure seamless integration and deployment. Prioritizes reliable infrastructure for frequent software deployments. Maintains system operational stability and focuses on CI/CD tooling.

challenge.name: The Locked Shadow
challenge.description: A supplier contract for the next promotion week is already signed, and the team cannot deploy the new model without a shadow run to verify it. #reliability_ruth# demands a fully automated and governed shadow environment to protect the live forecast, while #automation_alex# insists on keeping it manual to avoid breaking the current pipeline stability.

output.content: The rollback hand-over to the serving endpoint must be triggered by a metric threshold. I want the system to detect when forecast accuracy drops below the agreed standard and automatically revert to the previous stable model version. This removes the need for a human to watch dashboards during the critical morning order window. If the metric crosses the line, the pipeline should handle the switch instantly. This setup protects the live forecast from a bad deployment and ensures stores always receive a reliable order suggestion. I am pushing for this automation because manual intervention is too slow and prone to error during high traffic periods. The more automatic this protection is, the safer the entire deployment process becomes for the team and the stores.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states that the more automatic the protection is, the safer and happier the team and stores will be, indicating that exceeding the baseline requirement of simple automation leads to greater satisfaction.
